$comment: PT4 (D410) growth-led timing, suggestions only. Read by services/analytics/timing.mjs. From the AN1 numbers Ujwalam already stores (services/analytics, flag growth, read-only scopes; no new API scope), it groups the posts by the local time band and weekday they went public, and per kind. With at least minPosts posts that have a 24 h number, it may propose ONE schedule change with the numbers behind it. The change is a record in <data>/posting/growth-suggestion.json shown in the Posts window; nothing changes until the user clicks Apply. Apply writes the user's schedule settings (<data>/posting/schedule.json: placement custom, the same times each weekday), checked with the 60-minute floor like the card's Save; it is logged in <data>/posting/growth-log.jsonl and one click on Undo puts the earlier settings back. Exploration: at most exploreShare of the day's posts (rounded down, so at most 1 in 5) go to a band outside the best ones, picked by Thompson sampling (as RP5, services/learning/mix.mjs), so the estimate keeps learning.

metrics.views24h: views at the first stored fetch at least 24 h after the video went public (AN1 at24h; the fetch can be later than 24 h, so this is 24 h or a little more: UNVERIFIED as an exact 24 h count)
metrics.views7d: views at the first stored fetch at least 7 days after it went public (AN1 at7d; same caveat)
metrics.avgViewedPct: YouTube Analytics averageViewPercentage at the 24 h fetch (lifetime to that day; YouTube fills it a day or two late, so it can be missing)
metrics.subs: YouTube Analytics subscribersGained at the 24 h fetch (same delay)
metrics.viewerActivity: UNVERIFIED and not used: which Analytics report gives viewer activity by hour was not checked; no such number is read

source: plan docs/plan/2026-11-21-posting-text-schedule-growth.md PT4 (user 2026-11-21: suggest better times, ask approval, find optimum timings over time). minPosts 8 and exploration at most 1 in 5 slots: the plan. Bands (3 h in the day, 6 h at night), minPerBand 3, minLiftPct 10, maxMove 2, dismissDays 7, seed 1: agent proposal 2026-11-21 (D410), not user values; tune here.
